question: Is the data in CoVoST annotated for dialect?
title: CoVoST: A Diverse Multilingual Speech-To-Text Translation Corpus
answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 2 state that CoVoST is diversified with over 60 accents, and Text 6 confirms that a large portion of sentences are spoken in multiple accents for several languages, indicating dialect annotation.
